title: RomualdoMF/forest
description: Human SNV, SV, CNV, genotyping STR and modified base calling.

workflow.title: Workflow Options
workflow.description: Select which sub-workflows of forest you wish to run. Parameters for each sub-workflow can be changed using the sections below.

sv.title: SV: Structural variants
sv.help_text: If this option is selected, structural variant calling will be carried out using Sniffles2.

snv.title: SNV: Small variants
snv.help_text: If this option is selected, small variant calling will be carried out using Clair3.

cnv.title: CNV: Copy number variants
cnv.help_text: If this option is selected, copy number variant calling will be carried out with either Spectre (default) or QDNAseq. To use QDNAseq instead of Spectre, use the option --use_qdnaseq.

str.title: STR: Short tandem repeat expansions
str.description: Enable Straglr to genotype STR expansions.
str.help_text: If this option is selected, genotyping of STR expansions will be carried out using Straglr. This option will also automatically enable the SNV subworkflow as the STR caller requires a haplotagged BAM. This sub-workflow is only compatible with genome build hg38.

mod.title: MOD: Modified bases aggregation
mod.description: Enable output of modified calls to a bedMethyl file [requires input BAM with Ml and Mm tags]
mod.help_text: This option is automatically selected and aggregation of modified calls with be carried out using modkit if Ml and Mm tags are found. Disable this option to prevent output of a bedMethyl file.

tldr.title: tldr: Transposable element insertions
tldr.help_text: If this option is selected, tldr (https://github.com/adamewing/tldr) will run per-contig against the same haplotagged BAMs the STR subworkflow consumes, merging results into a single whole-sample table. Requires haplotagging, same as --str: turning --tldr on by itself is enough to trigger it, no need to also pass --phased.

input.title: Main options
input.description: Primary parameters for the data analysis.

sample_name.description: Sample name to be displayed in workflow outputs.
sample_name.help_text: When providing a MinKNOW experiment folder, the sample name must match one of the sample sub-folders in the input folder to specify which sample to analyse.

bam.title: Input: BAM file
bam.description: BAM or unaligned BAM (uBAM) files for the sample to use in the analysis.
bam.help_text: This accepts one of three cases: (i) the path to a single BAM file; (ii) the path to a folder containing BAM files; (iii) the path to a MinKNOW experiment folder containing sub-folders for each sample in the experiment. For cases (i) and (ii) an optional sample name can be supplied with `--sample_name`. For case (iii), a sample name must be provided to select the sample for analysis from the experiment folder.

ref.title: Reference file
ref.description: Path to a reference FASTA file.
ref.help_text: Reference against which to compare reads for variant calling.

minknow.title: Reference file for alignment
minknow.help_text:
Reference against which to compare reads for variant calling.

This workflow is only compatible with the hg19/GRCh37 or hg38/GRCh38 reference genomes. Please upload one of these to use this workflow.

bam_min_coverage.description: Minimum read coverage required to run analysis.

depth_window_size.help_text: This options specify the window size to use when computing the coverage along the genome.

bed.title: Target region BED file
bed.description: An optional BED file enumerating regions to process for variant calling. If a fourth column is present, this will be used to generate coverage metrics for the provided regions.

minknow.title: Optional .bed file for enumerating regions to process for variant calling

coverage_bed.title: Coverage region BED file
coverage_bed.description: An optional BED file enumerating regions to process for coverage metrics only. Requires a fourth BED column specifying region name in order to be valid.

annotation.help_text: If this option is unselected, VCFs will not be annotated with SnpEff.

phased.help_text: This option enables phasing of SV, SNV and modifications, depending on which sub-workflow has been chosen; see [README](README.md#9-phasing-variants) for more details.

include_all_ctgs.description: Call for variants on all sequences in the reference, otherwise small and structural variants will only be called on chr{1..22,X,Y,MT}.
include_all_ctgs.help_text: Enabling this option will call for variants on all contigs of the input reference sequence. Typically this option is not required as standard human reference sequences contain decoy and unplaced contigs that are usually omitted for the purpose of variant calling. This option might be useful for non-standard reference sequence databases.

output_report.description: Emits HTML reports for the individual analyses
output_report.help_text: By default, the workflow generates HTML reports summarising the results for each analysis; setting this value to `false` disables the reporting functions and the workflow will not output reports.

haplocheck.help_text: If set to true, the workflow will try to estimate the contamination level of the sample using [haplocheck](https://mitoverse.readthedocs.io/haplocheck/haplocheck/) on the mitogenome.

mitogenome.description: Sequence ID of the michondrial genome
mitogenome.help_text: By default, the workflow will attempt to extract the sequences mapping to the sequences called chrM, MT and Mt when assessing the contamination. If the mitochondrial genome has a different sequence ID, please provide it here.

igv.title: Show in IGV
igv.description: Visualize outputs in the EPI2ME IGV visualizer.
igv.help_text: Enabling this option will visualize the alignments and VCF files in the EPI2ME desktop app IGV visualizer.

out_dir.title: Output directory
out_dir.description: Directory for output of all workflow results.

partner.title: Partner integration
partner.description: Prepare outputs for tertiary analyses with partners (geneyx or fabric).

sv_options.title: Structural variant calling options
sv_options.description: Options specific to the SV calling subworkflow.

cluster_merge_pos.description: Maximum merging distance for insertions and deletions on the same read and cluster in non-repeat regions.

min_sv_length.description: Minimum structural variant size called by Sniffles2.

sv_benchmark_options.title: Structural variant benchmarking options
sv_benchmark_options.description: Options specific to automated benchmarking of the SV calling subworkflow.

sv_benchmark.help_text: If this option is selected, automated benchmarking of structural variant calls will be carried out using Truvari.

sv_benchmark_vcf.description: Override truthset VCF for benchmarking structural variants.
sv_benchmark_vcf.help_text: This option will use a custom VCF in place of the one bundled with the default 'NIST_SVs_Integration_v0.6' truth set. A Tabix index is required and will be expected to have the same path as the VCF with a '.tbi' extension.

sv_benchmark_bed.description: Override truthset BED for benchmarking structural variants.
sv_benchmark_bed.help_text: This option will use a custom BED in place of the one bundled with the default 'NIST_SVs_Integration_v0.6' truth set.

snv_options.title: Small variant calling options
snv_options.description: Options specific to the small variant calling subworkflow.

clair3_model_path.help_text: The workflow will attempt to map the basecalling model used to a suitable Clair3 model. You can override this by providing the path to a model with this option instead. Models can be obtained from [this page](https://cdn.oxfordnanoportal.com/software/analysis/models/clair3/index.html).

ref_pct_full.description: Expected percentage of low quality 0/0 variants called in the pileup mode for full-alignment mode calling.

var_pct_full.description: Expected percentage of low quality 0/1 and 1/1 variants called in the pileup mode for full-alignment mode calling.

snv_min_af.description: Minimum SNV AF required for a candidate variant.

indel_min_af.description: Minimum Indel AF required for a candidate variant.

vcf_fn.description: Candidate sites VCF file input, variants will only be called at the sites in the VCF file if provided.

min_cov.description: Minimum coverage required to call a variant (experimental).

min_mq.description: Reads with mapping quality < min_mq are filtered (experimental).

min_qual.description: Variants with >=min_qual will be marked 'PASS', or 'LowQual' otherwise, optional.

min_contig_size.description: Contigs with contig size < min_contig_size are filtered (experimental).

ctg_name.description: The name of the sequence to be processed.

refine_snv_with_sv.description: Refine SNV calls using calls from the SV subworkflow.
refine_snv_with_sv.help_text: By default when the SNV and SV subworkflows are both selected, the workflow will use the results of the SV subworkflow to refine the SNV calls. Disabling this option will stop the use of SV calls to refine low-coverage variant zygosity and variant phase to avoid impossible overlaps (e.g. homozygous SNVs falling in a large deletion called by Sniffles).

vcf_snv_min_qual.description: Minimum QUAL required to keep a Clair3 SNV/indel call.
vcf_snv_min_qual.help_text: Unlike min_qual above -- which only reaches Clair3's own CheckEnvs step and never actually filters output (every record keeps FILTER=PASS regardless of QUAL) -- this is enforced with an explicit `bcftools view -e 'QUAL<...'` filter run on the raw Clair3 VCF before normalisation/annotation (see filter_snv_vcf_by_qual_dp in modules/local/wf-human-snv.nf). Applies independently of --annotation.

vcf_snv_min_dp.description: Minimum FORMAT/DP (read depth) required to keep a Clair3 SNV/indel call.
vcf_snv_min_dp.help_text: Enforced by the same explicit bcftools filter as vcf_snv_min_qual (see filter_snv_vcf_by_qual_dp in modules/local/wf-human-snv.nf), independently of --annotation.

cnv_options.title: Copy number variant calling options
cnv_options.description: Options related to the copy number variant subworkflow.

use_qdnaseq.help_text: Set this to true to use QDNAseq for CNV calling instead of Spectre. QDNAseq is better suited to shorter reads such as those generated from adaptive sampling experiments.

qdnaseq_bin_size.description: Bin size for QDNAseq in kbp.
qdnaseq_bin_size.help_text: Pre-computed bin annotations are available for a range of bin sizes. Larger sizes reduce noise, however this may result in reduced sensitivity.

mod_options.title: Modified base calling options
mod_options.description: Options related to the modified bases aggregation subworkflow.

force_strand.title: Force strand
force_strand.description: Require modkit to call strand-aware modifications.
force_strand.help_text: By default strand calls are collapsed (strand reported as '.'). Enabling this will force stranding to be considered when calling modifications, creating one output per modification per strand and the report will be tabulated by both modification and strand.

str_options.title: Short tandem repeat expansion genotyping options
str_options.description: Options related to the STR subworkflow.

sex.title: Sample sex
sex.description: Sex (XX or XY) to be passed to Straglr-genotype.
sex.help_text: The sex determines how many calls will be obtained for all repeats on chrX. If not specified, the workflow will naively attempt to infer whether the sample carries XX or XY based on relative coverage of the allosomes.

str_repeat_bed.description: BED file of STR loci for Straglr to genotype.
str_repeat_bed.help_text: Defaults to STRchive's (https://github.com/dashnowlab/STRchive) pre-built hg38 straglr-format catalog, replacing the small 52-locus GeneReviews-only catalog forest originally shipped (data/wf_str_repeats.bed, left in the repo for reference but no longer used by default). Override to use a different catalog.

str_variant_catalog.description: Stranger-format JSON variant catalog used to annotate the STR VCF Straglr produces.
str_variant_catalog.help_text: Defaults to STRchive's (https://github.com/dashnowlab/STRchive) pre-built hg38 Stranger-format catalog, replacing forest's original data/variant_catalog_hg38.json. Override to use a different catalog -- must stay in sync with str_repeat_bed (same loci, both STRchive-published).

advanced_options.title: Advanced Options
advanced_options.description: Advanced options for configuring processes inside the workflow.
advanced_options.help_text: These advanced options do not need to be changed for typical use, but allow fine tuning of workflows for users who want more control over the workflow.

depth_intervals.description: Output a bedGraph file with entries for each genomic interval featuring homogeneous depth.
depth_intervals.help_text: The output [bedGraph](https://genome.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/help/bedgraph.html) file will have an entry for each genomic interval in which all positions have the same alignment depth. By default this workflow outputs summary depth information from your aligned reads. Per-base depth outputs are slower to generate but may be required for some downstream applications.

GVCF.description: Enable to output a gVCF file in addition to the VCF outputs (experimental).
GVCF.help_text: By default the the workflow outputs a VCF file containing only records where a variant has been detected. Enabling this option will output additionally a gVCF with records spanning all reference positions regardless of whether a variant was detected in the sample.

base_err.description: Estimated base error rate when enabling GVCF option (experimental).
base_err.help_text: Relevant only if running Clair3 in GVCF mode.

gq_bin_size.description: Default gq bin size for merge non-variant block when enabling GVCF option (experimental).
gq_bin_size.help_text: Relevant only if running Clair3 in GVCF mode.

downsample_coverage.description: Downsample the coverage to along the genome.
downsample_coverage.help_text: This options will trigger a downsampling of the read alignments to the target coverage specified by --downsample_coverage_target. Downsampling will make the workflow run faster but could lead to non-deterministic variant calls.

downsample_coverage_target.description: Average coverage or reads to use for the analyses.
downsample_coverage_target.help_text: This options will set the target coverage for the downsampling stage, if downsampling has been enabled.

downsample_coverage_margin.description: Downsample if the bam effective coverage / target coverage if greater than this value.
downsample_coverage_margin.help_text: By default, if the coverage of the input alignments is within 1.1x the target coverage, downsampling will not be performed even if it was enabled. This is to avoid triggering the downsampling of alignments when coverage is already close to the target coverage.

output_xam_fmt.description: Desired file format of alignment files created by alignment and phasing.
output_xam_fmt.help_text: This setting controls the file format of (1) alignment files created by aligning or re-aligning an input BAM and (2) alignment files with haplotag information created during phasing of an input BAM. If using QDNAseq for CNV calling, the setting will be ignored for alignment or realignment as QDNAseq requires BAM input.

modkit_args.title: Modkit additional arguments
modkit_args.help_text: This is an advanced option to allow running modkit with custom settings. The arguments specified in this option will fully override all options set by the workflow. To provide custom arguments to [modkit pileup](https://nanoporetech.github.io/modkit/advanced_usage.html#pileup) from command line proceed as follows: `--modkit_args="--preset traditional"`

sniffles_args.description: Additional command line arguments to pass to the Sniffles2 process
sniffles_args.help_text: The additional command line arguments will be passed directly to [Sniffles2](https://github.com/fritzsedlazeck/Sniffles/tree/v2.6.3); ensure to use the right commands for the version and from command line provide them as follows: `--sniffles_args="--mosaic"`.

spectre_args.title: Spectre additional arguments
spectre_args.description: Additional command line arguments to pass to the Spectre process
spectre_args.help_text: The additional command line arguments will be passed directly to [Spectre](https://github.com/epi2me-labs/ont-spectre); from the command line provide them as follows: `--spectre_args="--min-cnv-len 80000"`.

override_basecaller_cfg.title: Basecaller configuration
override_basecaller_cfg.description: Name of the model to use for selecting a small variant calling model.
override_basecaller_cfg.help_text: The workflow will attempt to find the basecaller model from the headers of your input data, providing a value for this option will override the model found in the data. If the model cannot be found in the header, it must be provided with this option as the basecaller model is required for small variant calling. The basecaller model is used to automatically select the appropriate small variant calling model. The model list shows all models that are compatible for small variant calling with this workflow. You should select 'custom' to override the basecaller_cfg with clair3_model_path.

tr_bed.title: Tandem repeat BED file
tr_bed.description: Input BED file containing tandem repeat annotations for the reference genome.
tr_bed.help_text: Providing a tandem repeat BED can improve calling in repetitive regions. The workflow will attempt to select an appropriate hg19 or hg38 TR BED depending on the genome detected, but this can be overridden with a custom TR BED with this parameter.

alignment_report_coverage_threshold.title: Alignment report coverage threshold
alignment_report_coverage_threshold.description: If a BED file is provided to the workflow, the "Regions below target coverage" section in the alignment report tabulates BED regions with mean coverage below this threshold.
alignment_report_coverage_threshold.help_text: This parameter is used to identify target regions where the mean coverage falls below a specified threshold

max_memory.description: Ceiling, in GB, for every task.attempt-scaled memory retry in the pipeline.
max_memory.help_text: See lib/MemoryScaling.groovy, used by mosdepth, dmr_calling, pileup_variants, evaluate_candidates, aggregate_*_variants, post_clair_phase_contig, post_clair_contig_haplotag, aggregate_all_variants, refine_with_sv, phase_contig, run_tapes, merge_tapes, call_tldr, callCNV and run_fastvep. No process will ever request more than this on a retry, however many attempts its own maxRetries allows -- each process' maxRetries is itself derived from this value, so raising/lowering it also changes how many times that process will retry. Lower it for a smaller host, e.g. --max_memory 64.

multiprocessing_options.title: Multiprocessing Options
multiprocessing_options.description: Options for configuring the common processes across the different subworkflows.
multiprocessing_options.help_text: These options do not need to be changed for typical use, but allow fine tuning of workflows for users who want more control over the workflow.

threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for more intense processes (limited by config executor cpus)

ubam_map_threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for aligning reads from uBAM (limited by config executor cpus)

ubam_sort_threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for sorting and indexing aligned reads from uBAM (limited by config executor cpus)

ubam_bam2fq_threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for uncompressing uBAM and generating FASTQ for alignment (limited by config executor cpus)

modkit_threads.description: Total number of threads to use in modkit modified base calling (limited by config executor cpus)

disable_ping.description: Enable to prevent sending a workflow ping.

fastvep_options.title: fastVEP annotation options
fastvep_options.description: Options for fastVEP (https://github.com/RomualdoMF/fastVEP), the functional-consequence/supplementary-annotation/ACMG-AMP classifier used in place of Ensembl VEP. Only relevant when --annotation is on.

fastvep_gff3.description: GFF3 gene model file fastVEP uses to predict transcript consequences.

fastvep_sa_dir.description: Directory of externally-prepared fastVEP supplementary annotation databases (.osa/.osa2, built with `fastvep sa-build`).
fastvep_sa_dir.help_text: Unlike the Ensembl VEP cache this replaces, this data is NOT auto-downloaded/auto-built by the workflow -- populate it yourself before running, and don't delete anything in there between runs. Bind-mounted into the fastVEP container at the same absolute host path (see base.config, withLabel:fastvep_annotation containerOptions).

fastvep_acmg.description: Run fastVEP's ACMG-AMP classification (Richards 2015 + ClinGen SVI).

fastvep_pick.description: Pick a single most-severe-consequence transcript per variant.

annotsv_options.title: AnnotSV annotation options
annotsv_options.description: Options for AnnotSV (https://github.com/lgmgeo/AnnotSV), structural variant annotation/ranking run on top of the fastVEP-annotated .sv.vcf.gz / .cnv.vcf.gz.

annotsv.description: Run AnnotSV to annotate/rank structural and copy number variants.
annotsv.help_text: Needs the AnnotSV container image built+pushed (see docker/annotsv/Dockerfile) and a large (~5GB) human annotation download on first use (see annotsv_annotations_dir).

annotsv_annotations_dir.help_text: Downloaded automatically on first run if empty (see modules/local/annotsv.nf) and reused afterwards. Bind-mounted into the AnnotSV container (see base.config, withLabel:annotsv containerOptions).

annotsv_human_annotations_version.description: Version of the AnnotSV human annotation data to download.

annotsv_sv_custom_args.description: Extra raw AnnotSV CLI flags for the SV path, e.g. ["-hpo", "HP:0001156"].
annotsv_sv_custom_args.help_text: AnnotSV's native `-vcf 1` output is currently broken (produces a header-only VCF, no records) so it is deliberately not included by default -- see the note in modules/local/annotsv.nf.

annotsv_cnv_custom_args.description: Extra raw AnnotSV CLI flags for the CNV path. See annotsv_sv_custom_args.

cnv_ensemble.description: Run the ISV + ClassifyCNV classification ensemble on top of AnnotSV's CNV output.
cnv_ensemble.help_text: ISV (tsladecek/isv_package) + ClassifyCNV (Genotek/ClassifyCNV), run on top of AnnotSV's .cnv.annotsv.tsv. Only meaningful when annotsv is also on, since it consumes AnnotSV's output directly. Publishes <sample>.cnv.annotated.tsv (AnnotSV+ISV+ClassifyCNV columns merged) and injects the same columns as INFO fields into .cnv.annotated.vcf.gz.

tapes_options.title: TAPES ACMG classification options
tapes_options.description: Options for TAPES (https://github.com/RomualdoMF/tapes), an additional ACMG/AMP classifier for the annotated SNV VCF.

tapes.description: Run TAPES ACMG/AMP classification on the fastVEP-annotated SNV VCF.
tapes.help_text: Needs --annotation. TAPES' classifier was written against Ensembl VEP's plugin-appended CSQ format and does not currently recognise fastVEP's CSQ/FV_* annotation layout, so it produces no output against a fastVEP-annotated VCF -- the pipeline falls back to publishing the fastVEP-only annotated VCF in that case (see the join in main.nf's SNV annotation block).

dmr_options.title: DMR (Differentially Methylated Region) calling options
dmr_options.description: Options for DMR calling via ont-methylDMR-kit's DSS/bsseq core (https://github.com/NyagaM/ont-methylDMR-kit). Both comparisons are opt-in and both require --mod.

dmr_haplotype_compare.description: Call DMRs between haplotype 1 and haplotype 2 of the same sample.

dmr_sample_compare.description: Call DMRs between this sample and an external reference.

dmr_sample_compare_reference.description: External reference for dmr_sample_compare: a BAM/CRAM (piled up on the fly) or an already-built bedmethyl, detected by file extension.

dmr_haplotype_compare_args.description: Literal ont-methylDMR-kit CLI flags for the haplotype comparison.
dmr_haplotype_compare_args.help_text: Annotation (gencode/imprinted) and the HTML report always run once DMRs are called; only plotting is gated by these. Pass a shorter/empty list to skip plotting. Recognised flags: --plot, --methylartist_only, --gene_list <path>, --imprinted.

dmr_sample_compare_args.description: Literal ont-methylDMR-kit CLI flags for the sample comparison. See dmr_haplotype_compare_args.

dmr_annotations_dir.description: Directory for the gencode promoter/exon/intron BED, imprinted gene list, and gencode GTF used to annotate/plot DMRs.
dmr_annotations_dir.help_text: Downloaded once, idempotently, from the pinned ont-methylDMR-kit commit into this directory on first use (see download_dmr_annotations in modules/local/dmr.nf).

tldr_options.title: tldr transposable element options
tldr_options.description: One parameter per tldr (https://github.com/adamewing/tldr) CLI option, except -b/--bams, -r/--ref, -o/--outbase, -c/--chroms, which the pipeline wires internally. Only relevant when --tldr is on.

tldr_elts.help_text: Defaults to the human reference data bundled inside the tldr image itself ($TLDR_REF_DIR=/opt/tldr/ref) -- no external download needed. Overriding requires the file to already be reachable inside the tldr container; there is no bind-mounted data directory for tldr.

tldr_nonref.description: Known non-reference (polymorphic) insertion sites, for annotation (tldr's -n/--nonref).
tldr_nonref.help_text: Bundled default is hg38 with "chr"-prefixed contigs. Override to "/opt/tldr/ref/nonref.collection.hg19.chr.bed.gz" for a hg19 reference, or set to null/false to disable -n entirely.

tldr_procs.description: Per-contig tldr process count (tldr's -p/--procs); also used as the process's cpus.

tldr_minreads.description: Minimum supporting reads to report an insertion (tldr's -m/--minreads).

tldr_embed_minreads.description: Minimum reads to embed in the output table (tldr's --embed_minreads).

tldr_min_alt_frac.description: Minimum alt allele fraction to report an insertion (tldr's --min_alt_frac).

tldr_min_alt_depth.description: Minimum alt allele read depth to report an insertion (tldr's --min_alt_depth).

tldr_min_total_depth_frac.description: Minimum fraction of total local depth required (tldr's --min_total_depth_frac).

tldr_max_cluster_size.description: Maximum read cluster size (tldr's --max_cluster_size). Unset (null) means no limit, tldr's own default.

tldr_wiggle.description: Positional wiggle room, in bp, when clustering candidate insertions (tldr's --wiggle).

tldr_flanksize.description: Flanking sequence length, in bp, used for consensus building (tldr's --flanksize).

tldr_color_consensus.description: Embed ANSI colour escape codes in the consensus sequence column (tldr's --color_consensus).
tldr_color_consensus.help_text: Fine to view with e.g. `less -R`, but will corrupt naive parsing of that column.

tldr_detail_output.description: Write tldr's detailed per-read output files (tldr's --detail_output).

tldr_extend_consensus.description: Extend consensus sequences by this many bp on each side (tldr's --extend_consensus).

tldr_trdcol.description: Add a transduction column to the output table (tldr's --trdcol).

tldr_use_pickles.description: Directory of .pickle files from a previous tldr_keep_pickles run to reuse (tldr's --use_pickles).

resources.run_time: Variable depending on whether it is targeted sequencing or whole genome sequencing, as well as coverage and the individual analyses requested. For instance, a 90X human sample run (options: `--snv --sv --mod --str --cnv --phased --sex XY`) takes less than 8h with recommended resources.
